intro: Sambarame Ika Madilo is the latest Christian Telugu Christmas song written by Prudhvi Raj, sung by Prudhvi Raj & Tinnu Thereesh and music and tune composed by Tinnu Thereesh. This song was released on November 15, 2025 through Moses Bliss YouTube channel.
